description: This file defines a PHP class 'Service' within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library, specifically within the Web namespace. The class provides static methods for making web service requests and URL encoding, functioning as helpers for spreadsheet calculations involving web services.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Provides static methods to perform web service interaction and URL encoding within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: webService
methods.description: Makes an HTTP GET request to the specified URL and returns the response content if valid, otherwise returns an Excel error.

methods.name: urlEncode
methods.description: Encodes a string for use in a URL, replacing '+' characters with '%20', or returns an error if input is not a string.
